data.name: Tagline
data.value: Fast, private local transfers — no account required.

data.name: QueueDescription
data.value: Queued transfers obey the concurrency limit in Settings. Finished queue rows contain status metadata only.

data.name: QueueEmpty
data.value: No queued or recent transfer work.

data.name: HistoryDescription
data.value: Stored only on this device. File contents and text contents are never stored in history.

data.name: AboutSummary
data.value: Open-source, account-free local-network file and text transfer built with .NET MAUI, C#, XAML, SQLite metadata, and TLS.

data.name: SupportDevelopmentDescription
data.value: SwiftDrop is open source. If you want to support continued development, you can use Buy Me a Coffee. Support is optional and does not unlock transfer features, priority handling, or access to private data.

data.name: SecurityReportNotice
data.value: Security vulnerabilities should be reported privately to sanskarin@outlook.in. Do not post secrets, private transfers, or exploit details in public issues.

data.name: PrivacySummary
data.value: SwiftDrop does not require an account and the current release does not upload transferred content to a SwiftDrop cloud service. Transfer metadata history stays local to this device.

data.name: BuyMeACoffeeDescription
data.value: Open the SwiftDrop Buy Me a Coffee support page

data.name: SettingsSummary
data.value: Transfers stay on your local network. Auto-accept is disabled by default.

data.name: ResetIdentityDescription
data.value: Resetting creates a new device ID and certificate and removes all local trusted-device relationships.

data.name: AutoAcceptTrusted
data.value: Auto-accept normal files from explicitly trusted devices

data.name: OptionalNotifications
data.value: Allow optional transfer completion/failure notifications where supported

data.name: LargerInterface
data.value: Use larger interface text and controls

data.name: NotificationRuleNote
data.value: SwiftDrop remains usable without optional notifications. Required foreground-service status, where imposed by an operating system, is controlled separately by platform rules.

data.name: LocalizationFallbackNote
data.value: English is the fallback language. Hindi strings use the same resource catalog and untranslated values safely fall back to English.

data.name: DeveloperDiagnosticsNote
data.value: Developer diagnostics must never expose transferred content, private keys, pairing nonces, or full pairing invitations.

data.name: NearbyDescription
data.value: SwiftDrop discovers peers through mDNS/Bonjour with UDP fallback. Devices expire automatically when they stop announcing.

data.name: ManualIpDescription
data.value: Use this only when automatic discovery is blocked. Enter the receiver IP address and its fresh 8-digit one-time code. SwiftDrop will still show the TLS certificate fingerprint for visual confirmation before transfer.

data.name: NearbyEmpty
data.value: No nearby devices found yet. QR, manual IP, or pasted invitations remain available.

data.name: TrustedDevicesDescription
data.value: Trust is tied to a device ID and certificate fingerprint. Revoke a device if it is lost, replaced, or reinstalled.

data.name: DiagnosticsPrivacyDescription
data.value: Diagnostics contain network capability and protocol status only. SwiftDrop does not include file contents, text contents, private keys, full pairing invitations, or pairing nonces.

data.name: QrFallbackNote
data.value: QR and pasted pairing invitations remain available when automatic discovery is blocked by Wi-Fi policy or platform restrictions.

data.name: SelfTestDescription
data.value: These tests use synthetic random bytes in temporary storage. They do not inspect user files or network peers.
